title: Node result
description: Structured output one graph node contributes when it finishes, in addition to its normal prose response. Its fields feed into the matching task-state arrays (evidence, findings, test_results, retries) rather than being stored standalone. Mirrors what code-review/security-review/completion-audit/ship-task already say in prose today (e.g. 'Gate: PASS | CHANGES REQUESTED') — this is a JSON mirror of that, not a new reporting format to learn.

summary.description: One or two sentences — what happened.

evidence.description: file:line references, command + report paths, verdict strings, MR/commit URLs.

attempt.description: Compared against the node's maximum_attempts in graph/nodes/<node_id>.md.

model_tier.description: From docs/rules/model-routing.md, for traceability only — that file remains the single source for the tier itself.

next_action.description: e.g. 'route to review', 'route to failure_route: implement', 'halt at ship STOP gate'.

failure_reason.description: Required in practice (not schema-enforced, since a human may still want partial detail) when status is failure or blocked.
